_comment: Error lines a PASSING test is expected to emit.
A test that asserts bad input is rejected will legitimately produce error
output: push_error is the correct way for a parser to report a bad file,
and the test proving it fires is a passing test. The gut stage fails on
error text by default, so declare the expected ones here.
Anything NOT declared still fails the stage. Every entry needs a 'why':
an unexplained allowance is how a real error gets hidden. A declared
error that never occurs is reported as stale, so this list cannot rot.
Do NOT use this to silence errors you have not understood. If an error is
a real defect, fix the defect.
